protocol.calibration: Quarterly inner origins start training_start+23 and end no later than outer_origin−12. Minimize origin-known L1 with ratio weights abs(endpoint); zero endpoints retain constant loss. Bound scale to [0.9,1.1].
protocol.candidate_ordering: Lowest development MAE, then model_id, among complete sixty-key recipes; WAPE shares numerator on same keys.
protocol.intervals: Unavailable; no uncertainty calibration or future accuracy assessment.
